name: Norman, Oklahoma, 20 May 2019 (evening balloon)
line: Very moist, very unstable air (CAPE about 4200 J/kg) with very strong wind shear (34 m/s over 6 km) that turns sharply near the ground.
note: The balloon launched at 0000 UTC on 21 May (7 pm local time on the 20th). The storm is started by a gentle push of rising air, as CM1's updraft nudging does. In a 1 km run the storm lasts the whole two hours (measured). This day's sounding in an idealized storm, not a reconstruction of that day's storms.

gm1_settings_why: The push of rising air that starts the storm is centred 8.7 km east and 7.9 km south of the centre, the storm-track check's recommended place for this sounding, so the storm keeps the most room to every side. CM1 keeps the nudging's centre in its code (xc_wnudge, yc_wnudge), not the namelist, so this is a GM1 setting.
